subject: STABLE lowering-opus blur-pyramid correctness (host): level-view passes and mismatched-size attachments now render; no snapshot for sampling another level
body: Cause (c6o xnu-live line=153): nord2_render_pass required a PAGE-aligned colour attachment offset; pyramid levels sit at 64-aligned level offsets (704x96 BGRA8: L2 337920, L3 354816, L4 359424 = exactly the device values, reproduced by the host allocator). Arch9 needs 64 (n2r refuses less; now also checks the single-target base). Same page check removed in the generic draw request builder (render_encoder.inc). line=163 'mismatched color attachments': Metal renders the common area (smallest attachment); a larger single-sample attachment is now rendered through a WINDOW view (its storage/offset/row stride, pass extent), owned by the encoder like the C6o level views; MSAA mismatch stays refused with sizes in the reason. Bridge: a texture binding of the target's BO now snapshots (wait_pending + SYNC + full-BO CPU copy per draw) only when its byte window overlaps the target's; sampling level L-1 while rendering L reads directly (was a CPU round trip per pyramid draw). Tests: CA host test +6 checks (levels 2..4, alone and next to a 704x96 second attachment: no refusal, level/window geometry, request offset/row, commit status 4) 47 checks PASS release+ASan; bridge test disjoint/overlap/past-end snapshot + unaligned-base refusal, 20 PASS x3; render oracle OK; iOS syntax x5 rc=0. NOT device verified. Hashes: nord2_render_pass.inc 2e5a7af6; render_encoder.inc 49850a40; nord2_metal_bridge.c b234cc6e; nord2_metal_render.c f4ee5fa7; nord2_metal_bridge_test.c 63e2c94f; ca_backboardd_host_test.py 4589637d;  Next: blur performance (per-job fixed cost).
